title: Front-load critical rules in SKILL.md + investigate session steering
description:
## Problem
Claude (me) acts like a cat at a keyboard when using interactive_shell:
1. Puts prompt in reason instead of command (agent sits idle)
2. Sends input without \\n or enter key (text appears but nothing happens)
3. Doesn't query/kill hands-free sessions (stares blankly)

## Solution
- Added CRITICAL RULES section at top of SKILL.md
- Created CHEATSHEET.md as backup reference
- Investigating how user can steer/redirect Claude during sessions

## Tasks
- [x] Diagnose the three core problems
- [x] Add critical rules to top of SKILL.md
- [x] Create branch and fork
- [x] Investigate session steering mechanisms
- [x] Document how user can redirect Claude mid-session

## Findings: Session Steering

Current architecture: When user types in hands-free overlay, input goes to SUBPROCESS, not back to controlling agent.

### What agent CAN see:
- `status: 'user-takeover'` when user types anything
- Output from subprocess (includes user's interaction)

### What's NOT possible today:
- User sending a 'note' directly to agent
- Agent receiving guidance without user fully taking over

### Proposed solution:
See docs/STEERING-PROPOSAL.md - add Ctrl+N hotkey for user to leave notes that agent sees in status queries.

title: Feature: User steering notes for hands-free sessions
description:
## Problem
Users watching a hands-free session have no way to guide the agent without fully taking over.

## Proposed Solution
Add a note mechanism:
- User presses Ctrl+N to open note input (doesn't trigger takeover)
- Note is stored in session state
- Agent sees `userNote` in status query results
- Agent can respond with `agentNote` that user sees in overlay

## Design Doc
See docs/STEERING-PROPOSAL.md

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Ctrl+N opens note input without triggering takeover
- [ ] Notes appear in status query results
- [ ] Agent can send notes back to user
- [ ] Notes display in overlay UI
- [ ] Notes cleared after acknowledgment
